name: Prop
formula: =LAMBDA(points,[unit],LET(shapeArr,points,strUnit,IF(ISOMITTED(unit),"mm",unit),PropTitles,VSTACK("Area","Centroid X Coor","Centroid Y Coor","Distance between Top Fibre to Centroid, yt","Distance between Bottom Fibre to Centroid, yb","Distance between Left Fibre to Centroid, xl","Distance between Right Fibre to Centroid, xr","2nd Moment of Area about the centroidal x-axis, Ixx","2nd Moment of Area about the centroidal y-axis, Iyy","Product of inertia about the centroid, Ixy","Elastic Section Modulus about x-axis at Top Fibre, Zxt","Elastic Section Modulus about x-axis at Bottom Fibre, Zxb","Elastic Section Modulus about y-axis at Left Fibre, Zyl","Elastic Section Modulus about y-axis at Right Fibre, Zyr","Elastic Section Modulus about x-axis, Zxx","Elastic Section Modulus about y-axis, Zyy"),Units,VSTACK(strUnit&"2",strUnit,strUnit,strUnit,strUnit,strUnit,strUnit,strUnit&"4",strUnit&"4",strUnit&"4",strUnit&"3",strUnit&"3",strUnit&"3",strUnit&"3",strUnit&"3",strUnit&"3"),x,CHOOSECOLS(shapeArr,1),y,CHOOSECOLS(shapeArr,2),xShift,VSTACK(DROP(x,1),TAKE(x,1)),yShift,VSTACK(DROP(y,1),TAKE(y,1)),cross,x*yShift-y*xShift,area,SUM(cross)/2,Cx,SUM((x+xShift)*cross)/(6*area),Cy,SUM((y+yShift)*cross)/(6*area),xMin,MIN(x),xMax,MAX(x),yMin,MIN(y),yMax,MAX(y),yt,yMax-Cy,yb,Cy-yMin,xl,Cx-xMin,xr,xMax-Cx,Ixx0,SUM(cross*(y^2+y*yShift+yShift^2))/12,Iyy0,SUM(cross*(x^2+x*xShift+xShift^2))/12,Ixy0,SUM(cross*(x*yShift+2*x*y+2*xShift*yShift+xShift*y))/24,Ixx,ABS(Ixx0-area*Cy^2),Iyy,ABS(Iyy0-area*Cx^2),Ixy,Ixy0-area*Cx*Cy,Zxt,Ixx/yt,Zxb,Ixx/yb,Zyl,Iyy/xl,Zyr,Iyy/xr,Zxx,MIN(Zxt,Zxb),Zyy,MIN(Zyl,Zyr),Props,VSTACK(ABS(area),Cx,Cy,yt,yb,xl,xr,Ixx,Iyy,Ixy,Zxt,Zxb,Zyl,Zyr,Zxx,Zyy),HSTACK(PropTitles,Props,Units)))
comment: Returns elastic section properties of a simple polygon as a 16×3 array of name, value, and unit. points is an n×2 array in vertex order, column 1 x and column 2 y, with no repeated closing vertex. Area is positive. Ixx, Iyy, Ixy, and the section moduli are about the centroid. Zxx is the smaller of Zxt and Zxb. Zyy is the smaller of Zyl and Zyr. unit defaults to mm and labels the units only. A zero-area polygon returns #DIV/0!. Fewer than two columns returns #VALUE!. Non-numeric coordinates return #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
